heading: Cybersecurity, Compliance and Managed IT — Under One Accountable Partner
intro: Aadit Technologies is a cybersecurity, compliance and managed IT services company that has worked with businesses since 2017. We run security testing and 24/7 monitoring, take organisations through ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR and India’s DPDP Act, and operate the IT that everything else depends on — with one team accountable for all three.

Why companies come to us: Three situations bring most clients through the door.

An enterprise buyer has asked for proof. A customer’s security review arrives before the contract does, and the questionnaire asks for a certification you do not hold and a penetration test you have not run. We close that gap and keep it closed.
Something happened. A breach, a ransomware incident, or an alert nobody could explain. We contain it, find the root cause, and build the monitoring that would have caught it earlier.

IT stopped scaling. The team that ran IT at 40 people cannot run it at 200. Support tickets pile up, patching slips, and nobody owns the cloud bill. We take over operations so the internal team can go back to doing work that moves the business.
Cybersecurity: Security testing, monitoring and response, delivered by people who do this daily rather than occasionally.

VAPT and penetration testing — manual testing alongside automated scanning across web applications, mobile apps, APIs, networks and cloud. Every finding comes with a risk rating, remediation guidance written for your stack, and a retest to confirm closure.
Managed SOC — 24/7 monitoring by our analysts across your endpoints, network, identity and cloud, with alerts triaged before they reach you and reporting your auditors will accept.
SOC as a Service — a full security operations capability on subscription, without building the team or buying the platform.
Incident response — containment, root cause, recovery and the reporting obligations that follow.
Endpoint security, email security and network security — the controls that stop most attacks before they start, deployed and maintained rather than sold and forgotten.
Risk assessment and security consulting — for organisations that need to know where they stand before deciding what to buy.
Compliance and audit readiness: We take organisations from no formal programme to a certificate or a clean report, and stay through the audit.
ISO 27001 — gap assessment, ISMS scope and risk assessment, policy and control implementation, internal audit, and support through both stages of the certification audit.
SOC 2 — Type I and Type II readiness, control design, evidence collection built to survive the observation window, and auditor coordination. Start with our SOC 2 readiness checklist.
PCI DSS — scoping, remediation and audit support for anyone handling card data.
HIPAA and GDPR — for healthcare data and EU personal data respectively.
DPDP Act — data inventory, consent flows, notices, data principal rights and grievance handling, so you are ready before enforcement rather than after.
ISO 42001 and ISO 9001 — AI management systems and quality management.
Not sure which framework your buyers actually need? Read our comparison of SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
Managed IT services: The IT function, run properly, for a predictable monthly fee.
Managed IT services — monitoring, patching, asset management and vendor coordination under defined service levels.
Help desk and support — 24/7 support for your people, with response targets that are measured rather than promised.
Cloud migration, cloud infrastructure and cloud optimization — moving to AWS, Azure or Google Cloud with security built in, then running it without the bill growing unchecked.
Backup and disaster recovery — backups that run, and restores that have been tested.
Who we work with: Startups and scaleups — right-sized security and the certification needed to close enterprise deals and pass investor due diligence.
Healthcare and BFSI — HIPAA, RBI cybersecurity guidelines, PCI DSS and ISO 27001, with continuous monitoring.
E-commerce and fintech — PCI DSS, GDPR and DPDP, fraud prevention, and application and API security testing.
Why one partner for all three: Security, compliance and IT are usually bought from three different vendors, and the gaps between them are where incidents happen. The compliance consultant writes a policy that the IT provider never implements. The security vendor finds a vulnerability that nobody is contracted to fix. The evidence an auditor wants sits in a system none of them operate.

When one team runs all three, the evidence for your audit comes out of the monitoring you already pay for, the controls on paper are the controls actually running, and there is one number to call when something breaks.
How an engagement starts: A conversation about what triggered this — a customer requirement, an incident, a deadline, or growth.
An assessment that tells you where you actually stand, not where a brochure says you should be.
A scoped proposal with what is included, what it costs, and how long it takes.
Delivery, with a named point of contact and reporting you can take to your board.

faqs.question: Where is Aadit Technologies based?
faqs.answer: Aadit Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is headquartered in Bengaluru, India, at New BEL Road, RMV 2nd Stage, and was founded in January 2017. We work with clients across India, the United States and the United Arab Emirates.

faqs.question: What services does Aadit Technologies provide?
faqs.answer: Three practices: cybersecurity, including VAPT, managed SOC, SOC as a Service, incident response and endpoint, email and network security; compliance, covering ISO 27001, ISO 42001, ISO 9001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR and India’s DPDP Act; and managed IT services, covering help desk, infrastructure operations, cloud migration and backup and disaster recovery.

faqs.question: Is Aadit Technologies the same as Aadit Techno Solutions?
faqs.answer: No. Aadit Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (CIN U72900KA2017PTC099151) is a cybersecurity, compliance and managed IT services company based in Bengaluru. Aadit Techno Solutions (aadittech.com) is a separate and unrelated defence electronics company.

faqs.question: Do you work with companies outside India?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with clients in India, the United States and the United Arab Emirates, and we support certification programmes against international standards including ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA and GDPR.

faqs.question: How quickly can you start?
faqs.answer: An initial assessment can usually begin within a week of scoping. Incident response is faster — if you are dealing with an active incident, contact us directly rather than through the form.

faqs.question: Do you only work with large enterprises?
faqs.answer: No. A substantial part of our work is with startups and mid-sized companies that need certification to close an enterprise deal, and with growing businesses whose IT has outpaced their internal team.

keyTakeaways.text: Aadit brings cybersecurity, compliance programmes and day-to-day IT operations under one team, rather than splitting responsibility across separate vendors.
Aadit Technologies is headquartered in Bengaluru and works with organisations in India, the United States and the United Arab Emirates.
Aadit supports compliance engagements with scoping, control implementation, evidence collection and auditor coordination, from the initial assessment through the audit.
Aadit works with startups, mid-sized companies and enterprises whose certification requirements or security and IT operations need additional capacity.
